chapter_title_en: The Little Stone Emperor's Final Step
chapter_seo_title: Xiao Shi Huang Falls – Eight Stone Kings Clash for the Three Sovereign Mirror
chapter_meta_description: The Little Stone Emperor ascends in glory, leaving behind the Three Sovereign Mirror and seven demon stars. Eight Stone-Man Kings wage war for the treasure, while Xiao Chen and Keke loot the tombs and face the Stone Corpse.
og_title: The Glorious End of Xiao Shi Huang and the Battle of the Eight Kings
og_description: Xiao Shi Huang's transcendence triggers a bloody free-for-all among eight Stone-Man Kings. Xiao Chen and Keke exploit the chaos, collecting treasures and confronting the Stone Corpse.
